name: grebe
description: DuckDB SQL diagnostics, quick fixes and formatting via the grebe LSP server

grebe.path.description: Path to the grebe executable. Leave empty to use the binary bundled with this extension, then ~/.local/bin/grebe, then grebe on PATH. A path set here is checked with `--version` before the server starts, and used without falling back.

grebe.select.description: The MOD rules to lint for, same as the grebe CLI's --select flag. Only the MOD rules listed here run, and any of them that are off by default are turned on. The default, ["ALL"], is every MOD rule there is -- including ones added after this setting, so the editor stays loud rather than needing an update to see a new rule; list codes explicitly to pick a subset instead. Parse errors (PRS) and other-dialect notices (SRC) are always shown unless set to off in grebe.toml's [severity].
